reviews.comment: Her lectures were very dragging and the way she teaches and approaches discussions are in only ways that enforce her own. She had a weird format in her quizzes and the end, it made me hate going to classes, participating, and watching her lectures. Do not recommend it if you already know enough of women writers.

Dr. Robinson has been one of the best professors I've had at Texas A&M. ENGL 303 had some great readings, and if you like writing (or want to get better at it), this is a great course. There are some quizzes, but not too many. Dr. Robinson is also a very fair and understanding grader, and also a very nice person to talk to. Highly recommended!

If you don't have insight into feminist theory, I would not recommend this professor. She is nice if you contribute to the conversations in the way she wants, but if you digress from the canon opinion, you will bear the brunt of excess criticism. However, that criticism will not be reflected in your grades, only in discussion.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Robinson is nice to you if you participate in class, ask questions and show that you are interested. The discussions are very important and you need to make sure you're ready. Wrote 3 papers, an 8-page paper for the final. One time she did yell at us because no one was contributing. Participate, act like an adult and communicate with her.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: You will probably read around 8 books (between 300 and 100 pages each). A lot of which are available online (if you know where to look) and as audio books on youtube in case you are not a fast reader or want to listen while doing other things. Lectures are great and as long as you pay attention to them you should ace the exams (no joke)
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Robinson, I believe, is the best prof I have ever had the privilege of taking a class with. While she may seem like a tough grader, she is genuinely there to help you and make you a better writer. If you are not serious about literature, I probably would not recommend this class, as it is a lot of reading and papers. All in all she is amazing!!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Love love love Dr. Robinson! This course had us reading four-five books, but she made it manageable and exciting. Every class was filled with amazing discussions, and we were able to relax and be ourselves. No tests, but we did have four papers over the semester. Dr. Robinson is an amazing professor who cares about her students.

Dr. Robinson is great. The class is tough, although not unreasonable, and she expects you to act like an adult via showing up, participating, and putting in a generally good effort; if you do all of those things, she is super helpful and is more than willing to work with you if you need it.

Dr. Robinson expects you to participate during class discussions.  Lots of books and gives a very short amount of time to read them, but it's doable.  She's a super fair grader and it is not hard to make an A in this class if you show up and do your work.  Wrote 3 essays and an 8 page paper as the final.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Robinson is great. The course isn't the most interesting if you don't absolutely love English but frankly most English courses are this way. There are lots of papers which can be really tough, but she grades them fairly and is very accessible outside of class. She is also super caring-I made a major mistake in the class and she helped me anyway

I am not sure why this prof has such good ratings. She expected us to keep up with an insane amount of reading but she took extra long with her lectures. We would get lecture notes like 3 weeks after reading that book. 11 books + pdfs, she gives you barely any time to complete the readings. She is a hard grader, and tests are difficult. STAY AWAY!!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I loved this professor. She's wonderful. She's interesting, and her class isn't difficult if you show up and pay attention. Would definitely recommend.

I LOVED this professor! She was hilarious and her lectures made my day. She assigns a lot of books, but as long as you read them and attend class, you won't have any trouble. Her tests questions comes directly from the lectures and reading and aren't hard at all if you pay attention. One of the best profs I've ever had. She's fantastic!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures
